title: Rules of Hooks: where you may call them

slides.say: Hooks have two rules: call them at the top level, and only from React functions.
Good spots: the top level of a component, or the top level of a custom Hook, before any early return.
Bad: this Hook only runs when cond is false. Move it above the return.

slides.text: Never in: conditions, loops, event handlers, class components, try/catch, or functions passed to useMemo or useEffect.
slides.say: Also never inside conditions, loops, event handlers, class components, try and catch, or functions you pass to use memo or use effect.

slides.text: The eslint-plugin-react-hooks linter catches these for you.
slides.say: You don’t have to check by hand. The React Hooks lint plugin catches these mistakes.
